title: Web search (SearXNG + Brave) and page fetch
covers: company facts such as founding, leadership, products and pricing
query_style: Plain words with the exact names and the year when the question is about the current state. Short queries beat long ones. One fact per query.
weak_at: exact figures that sit in tables (recall is unreliable)
anything that must be exact to the digit without a primary page
time_behavior: Pages carry publish dates (collected by the temporal skill); search can be limited to day, week, month or year.
evidence_tier: secondary, or primary when the page is on the company's own domain
limits: Politeness limits per host; some sites block automated fetches (HTTP 403).
